blob.design: A lumpy opaque magenta jelly monster with two stacked asymmetrical rounded lobes, short dripping pseudopods, tiny blank black oval eyes and one short flat mouth. Clearly different from the approved smooth blue slime. Simple uncanny face, no human expression, no equipment.

skeleton.design: A short chibi skeleton monster, large ivory skull with deep slanted black eye sockets and simple small tooth line, thin complete ribcage and bony limbs, tiny tattered muted blue waist cloth. Empty claw hands, no weapon, no shield. Malicious skeletal face, not smiling human, clear readable bone silhouette.

archer.design: A squat wicked woodland imp archer, olive-mustard skin, bald head beneath a simple short dark olive hood, angular long ears, narrow glaring simple white eyes and dark pupils, short fanged mouth. Wears moss-brown leather vest. Holds one small wooden bow in ANATOMICAL LEFT HAND and a short arrow in RIGHT hand, quiver on back. Clearly a bow enemy, never a club goblin. No hair. Keep bow handedness in every view.

thief.design: A compact upright raccoon-dog tanuki thief monster with brown fur, cream belly, black mask around narrow malicious eyes, round ears, short muzzle, small sly fanged mouth, bushy striped tail. Both paws clutch one little dark green stolen-goods pouch against belly. Original Japanese tanuki animal enemy with wicked simple face, no human hair, no huge human eyes.

sleepy.design: A squat walking sleep mushroom monster: oversized dusty periwinkle blue cap with a few large pale spots, cream stubby stalk body, tiny root feet, two very simple narrow dark sleepy eyes and tiny flat mouth on stalk. Slightly uncanny and comical, NOT a human child. No arms, no equipment. Cap and gills visible appropriately on back views.

bomb.design: A stocky round orange-brown explosive beetle monster, shiny segmented armored round abdomen with dark seam, six short articulated black legs, two angry simple slanted pale eyes, tiny mandibles, two stubby antennae. A tiny ember-orange marking on carapace hints at explosive behavior, NO real bomb prop or text. Ground beetle, NO wings. Beast enemy malicious face with a comical squat silhouette.

ogre.design: A broad heavy stocky orange-russet ogre monster, bald head, two tiny ivory forehead horns, heavy low brow, narrow hostile simple eyes, short mouth with two tusks. Thick bare muscular arms with empty clenched fists, short thick legs, simple brown ragged loincloth. Original chibi monster, large shoulders, squat strong body, not human child, no weapon or hair.

dazzle.design: A squat pink-mauve magical frog monster, big rounded frog head, cream throat pouch, four webbed feet, squat crouched body with no clothes. Two small narrow sinister eyes on top of head with simple pale sclera and dark slit pupils, short flat sly mouth, a few round dark skin spots. Clearly a frog beast, slightly comic but enemy-like, no human hair or human smile.

venom.design: A hovering poisonous wasp monster, golden yellow and dark charcoal striped body, compact angular insect head, narrow angry white eyes with dark pupils, pointed dark stinger at tail, six tiny jointed legs, two pairs of translucent pale bluish wings, stubby antennae. Original chibi beast enemy with a clear threatening stinger and simplified hostile face, no clothing. Keep entire wings within cell.

ghost.design: A floating pale icy-blue ghost monster with soft rounded sheet-like body and tapering curling tail, two short drooping wisp arms, simple sinister black slanted eye holes and a tiny dark oval mouth. Soft painted spectral glow confined within silhouette, lightly translucent edges, no human anatomy or clothing, original playful spooky enemy. View from back shows smooth ghost back without face.

minotaur.design: A stocky powerful minotaur bull monster: tawny brown fur, large bull head with two symmetrical curved ivory horns, broad dark muzzle, narrowed malicious simple eyes, hoof feet, thick muscular torso, simple dark brown leather belt and loincloth. Both empty fists raised at waist, NO weapon or shield. Clearly a horned bull-headed biped, not an ogre. Chibi proportions with large head and heavy chest.

dragon.design: A small squat quadruped dragon monster with ember orange scales, cream belly, broad reptilian snout, two short swept horns, narrow malicious pale eyes with dark slit pupils, small fangs, four chunky clawed feet, two compact bat-like wings folded partly open, thick curling tail with a small arrowhead tip. Original full dragon creature, not humanoid. Cute-bodied but threatening face. Entire tail and wings must remain inside frame, no fire effect at idle.
